name: Time-Bomb Tech
description: Precursor ruins hold research with huge bonuses and a planet-killing failure mode, and the Cult knows how to trigger it. Every year a cult cell on a colony whose empire (or, after secession, the cult itself) holds the tech may detonate it as an act of terror; at war, the theocracy does so on purpose. Needs The Cult: the Time Bomb stays inert until the Cult flag is on.
